purpose: Convert a preview-only V14 evidence batch into a deterministic owner-readable coverage and gap plan without applying any state change.

owner_actions.github-canonical-repository: Identify the exact canonical GitHub repository and collect one current nonsecret repository-observation receipt.
owner_actions.render-central-service: Identify the exact approved Render central service and collect one current nonsecret dark-deployment receipt.
owner_actions.postgres-database: Collect one current nonsecret PostgreSQL provider receipt covering connection, migration, backup, and restore evidence.
owner_actions.transactional-email: Collect one current nonsecret transactional-email receipt covering sender authentication, delivery, bounce handling, and secret absence.
owner_actions.domains-dns-tls-health: Collect one current nonsecret domain receipt covering canonical URL, DNS, TLS, health, and redirect policy.
owner_actions.openai-central-gateway: After the protected key action, collect one controlled nonsecret OpenAI central-gateway smoke receipt with kill-switch and fallback evidence.
owner_actions.neutral-boardroom-billing: Collect one current nonsecret billing receipt covering seller boundary, entitlements, webhooks, refunds, and secret absence.
owner_actions.production-deployment: After all dependency receipts pass, collect a separate exact deployment receipt with monitoring, rollback, and detached owner GO evidence.
